from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    seen=set(); objs=[]
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        color=grid[r][c]
        if not color or (r,c) in seen: continue
        q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
        while q:
          y,x=q.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
          for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            p=(y+dy,x+dx)
            if 0<=p[0]<h and 0<=p[1]<w and p not in seen and grid[p[0]][p[1]]==color:
              seen.add(p); q.append(p)
        objs.append((color,cells))
    # rightmost objects settle first
    objs.sort(key=lambda o:max(c for r,c in o[1]), reverse=True)
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for color,cells in objs:
      shift=0
      while all(c+shift+1<w and out[r][c+shift+1]==0 for r,c in cells):
        shift+=1
      for r,c in cells: out[r][c+shift]=color
    return out
